name: knowledge_ingest
description: Ingest a document into z-agent-knowledge RAG knowledge base. The document is automatically chunked, embedded, and indexed for semantic search + RAG. Use this when the CEO agent needs to persist: a lesson learned (05_memory/what_works or what_fails), a strategy decision, a spec snippet, or any text that should be retrievable later via semantic search. The knowledge base is identified by `knowledgeBaseCode` (use 'ceo_lessons' for ceo_room's memory layer). Returns the new document id. Note: ingestion is synchronous but embedding/indexing is async — allow a few seconds before the new doc is queryable.

knowledgeBaseCode.description: Knowledge base identifier. For ceo_room memory layer use 'ceo_lessons'. Other valid codes can be discovered via knowledge_list skill (FEATURE024 follow-up).

docCode.description: Unique document code within the knowledge base. Suggested format: '{section}/{slug}', e.g. 'what_works/rag-vec-cost' or 'what_fails/over-engineering-1'.

title.description: Document title, shown in search results. Keep it short and descriptive.

content.description: Full document body, plain text or markdown. Will be chunked automatically (default 500 tokens/chunk with 50 token overlap).

category.description: Categorical type. For ceo_room memory layer, use 'what_works' for 05_memory/what_works/* and 'what_fails' for 05_memory/what_fails/*. Default 'other'.
